name: Essaouira
tagline: A breezy Atlantic port of ramparts, gulls and kitesurfers
summary: Essaouira is a laid-back fortified port on the Atlantic, with a white-and-blue medina, sea ramparts used in Game of Thrones, a busy fishing harbour and a wide windy beach for kitesurfing. It's a calm contrast to Marrakech, three hours away.
seasonNote: Mild year-round; summer is cooler than inland but very windy, perfect for kitesurfing. The Gnaoua music festival is in June.
arrival: Buses from Marrakech take about 3 hours. A small airport has a few European flights.
cashTip: Carry small dirham notes for meals, taxis and markets; cards work mainly in hotels and bigger restaurants.
foodTip: Grilled sardines and fish at the port, tagines and amlou almond-argan spread.
buyTip: Thuya wood boxes, argan oil and paintings.
